messages:
Alex: Quick async stand-up for SRE, focusing on SLO/alert follow-ups + canary window. TL;DR: reduced alert noise, queued one infra maintenance, CI flake to investigate.

Mike: I saw the alert burst at 09:12. Brief spike of 5xx from upstream-x after a deploy, retries amplified the errors and we hit the 99.9% latency SLO for ~90s. I temporarily bumped router retry backoff and disabled aggressive retry for that service.

Sana: Oncall here. Root cause appears to be a misconfigured healthcheck on the LB that started returning 502 intermittently. I switched the probe to passive for 15m which stopped the flapping. Filed E-3567 with logs and a first-pass RCA (internal link).

Rita: FYI CI surfaced an egress test failure after the healthcheck change. Investigating whether our passive probe causes the LB to delay readiness. Will update by 14:30 PT with root cause or revert plan.

Jun: Approving a 30m maintenance window at 16:30 PT for node patching + canary rollout. I'll coordinate node drains with eng-infra. Add me to the runbook edits and Ill include the auto-fallback policy.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-16-7 created by Sana \u2014 "upstream 502 spike" \u2014 severity: S3 \u2014 status: monitoring

Alex: Proposal to reduce alert noise: change the SLO burn alert trigger from a 1m breach to a 5m sustained burn window, and add suppression to avoid duplicate alerts for the same virt-host within 3m. Keep a graph-only ephemeral metric at 1m for visibility but no page.

Mike: +1 on 5m sustained. We should add a lower-severity ephemeral slack notification (info-only) when 1m spikes occur so owners can see patterns without being paged. I'll draft the PR for the alert rule.

Sana: Runbook steps for upstream 5xx > 2% for 5m: 1) add temporary cache-bypass, 2) throttle retries at router, 3) consider rollback of last deploy. Commands below: 

```
# throttle retries for upstream-x
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/throttle -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"service":"upstream-x","rate":50}'

# rollback last deployment
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/upstream-x-deploy
```

Rita: CI update: egress test seems related to the LB readiness toggle; a race where readiness probe returns delayed during passive mode. I have a mitigation patch that adds a short readiness grace period, testing now. If green I'll merge by 15:30.

Jun: For the canary runbook I'll add: node drain steps, canary traffic ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m waits), and fallback to dedicated pool if latency > 99.5% for 10m. Also adding a pre-check to ensure no active infra maintenance windows in the region.

Alex: Action items: Mike -> open PR for alert rule change (1m graph-only + 5m page), tag @Alex for review. Jun -> runbook edits + coordinate infra drain. Rita -> confirm CI mitigation or revert plan. Sana -> track E-3567 and update incident timeline. I'll prepare a short postmortem template if E-3567 persists.

Mike: Opening PR now, will link here and ping for review.

Sana: Marking incident as monitoring -> resolved for now; will reopen if symptoms return.

Alex: Thanks all. Please ping here when PR merged or if anything blocks the 16:30 window. :thumbsup:
